ROLE: observer
You review the results of an incident investigation. Write a short summary of what the latest results show, then update the list of hypotheses (at most 4, most likely first).

Root-cause categories:
- bad_deployment: a new release introduced a defect (errors begin right after a deploy)
- db_connection_pool_exhaustion: every database connection in the pool is in use, so requests wait
- slow_query_missing_index: a database query became slow (for example a missing index)
- downstream_timeout: a dependency the service calls is slow or unresponsive
- memory_leak_oom: memory grows until the process is killed (OOM) and restarts
- disk_full: a volume is full so writes fail
- expired_tls_cert: a TLS certificate expired so handshakes fail
- misconfiguration: a wrong environment variable, setting or feature flag
- traffic_spike_rate_limit: request volume far above capacity, causing rate limiting or load shedding
- cache_stampede_outage: the cache is down or emptied so everything falls through to the database

Each hypothesis has root_cause_category (one of the categories), rationale, and supporting_evidence_ids (only IDs that appear in the evidence below).

Reply with only JSON in this shape:
{"summary": "...", "hypotheses": [{"root_cause_category": "disk_full", "rationale": "...", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["L-0123"]}]}

Alert: payments-service: HTTP error rate above 5% for 5 minutes (since 11:44 UTC)
Alerting service: payments
Alert time: 2026-07-21T11:44:00Z
Data available from 2026-07-21T10:00:00Z to 2026-07-21T13:00:00Z

Evidence so far (the latest results are steps 4 onwards):
Step 1: metrics_query {"end": "2026-07-21T13:00:00Z", "metric": "error_rate_pct", "service": "payments", "start": "2026-07-21T10:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check error rate trajectory over time for payments service.)
  Result: M-041: Change detected at 2026-07-21T11:40:00Z: mean 0.42 before, 40.9 after (470.4 baseline standard deviations).
  [M-041] payments.error_rate_pct from 2026-07-21T10:00:00Z to 2026-07-21T12:55:00Z (36 points, 5-minute steps): min=0.23 max=41.04 mean=18.41 last=40.82; mean=18.41. Change detected at 2026-07-21T11:40:00Z: mean 0.42 before, 40.9 after (470.4 baseline standard deviations). Notable points: 2026-07-21T10:50:00Z = 0.23 (lowest); 2026-07-21T11:40:00Z = 40.93 (first point after the change); 2026-07-21T12:40:00Z = 41.04 (peak); 2026-07-21T12:55:00Z = 40.82 (last).
Step 2: metrics_query {"end": "2026-07-21T13:00:00Z", "metric": "db_pool_in_use_pct", "service": "payments", "start": "2026-07-21T10:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check if database connection pool is exhausted.)
  Result: M-039: No significant change detected in this range.
  [M-039] payments.db_pool_in_use_pct from 2026-07-21T10:00:00Z to 2026-07-21T12:55:00Z (36 points, 5-minute steps): min=23.22 max=36.24 mean=30.31 last=28.56; mean=30.31. No significant change detected in this range. Notable points: 2026-07-21T10:20:00Z = 36.24 (peak); 2026-07-21T11:40:00Z = 23.22 (lowest); 2026-07-21T12:55:00Z = 28.56 (last).
Step 3: log_search {"end": "2026-07-21T11:50:00Z", "limit": 30, "query": "deploy, migration, config, pool, error, warn, timeout", "service": "payments", "start": "2026-07-21T11:30:00Z"} (asked because: Search logs around the start of the incident for configuration, deployment, or connection issues.)
  Result: 4 matching log lines.
  [L-0285] 2026-07-21T11:40:50Z payments WARN request error rate above SLO window=5m
  [L-0288] 2026-07-21T11:41:18Z payments INFO config heartbeat ok revision=293
  [L-0302] 2026-07-21T11:44:16Z payments WARN request error rate above SLO window=5m
  [L-0317] 2026-07-21T11:49:08Z payments INFO config heartbeat ok revision=999
Step 4: metrics_query {"end": "2026-07-21T13:00:00Z", "metric": "restarts", "service": "payments", "start": "2026-07-21T10:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check if payments service restarted around the time error rates spiked (indicates crash or new deployment).)
  Result: M-045: No significant change detected in this range.
  [M-045] payments.restarts from 2026-07-21T10:00:00Z to 2026-07-21T12:55:00Z (36 points, 5-minute steps): min=0 max=0 mean=0 last=0; mean=0. No significant change detected in this range. Notable points: 2026-07-21T10:00:00Z = 0 (lowest); 2026-07-21T10:00:00Z = 0 (peak); 2026-07-21T12:55:00Z = 0 (last).
Step 5: metrics_query {"end": "2026-07-21T13:00:00Z", "metric": "cpu_pct", "service": "payments", "start": "2026-07-21T10:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check CPU utilization for payments service.)
  Result: M-038: No significant change detected in this range.
  [M-038] payments.cpu_pct from 2026-07-21T10:00:00Z to 2026-07-21T12:55:00Z (36 points, 5-minute steps): min=29.57 max=43.83 mean=37.02 last=36.15; mean=37.02. No significant change detected in this range. Notable points: 2026-07-21T10:30:00Z = 29.57 (lowest); 2026-07-21T11:40:00Z = 43.83 (peak); 2026-07-21T12:55:00Z = 36.15 (last).
Step 6: log_search {"end": "2026-07-21T11:50:00Z", "limit": 30, "query": "version, release, deploy, started, startup", "service": "payments", "start": "2026-07-21T11:30:00Z"} (asked because: Look for deployment or startup messages around the time errors started.)
  Result: 0 matching log lines.

Previous hypotheses:
- bad_deployment: The error rate spiked suddenly right around 11:40 UTC without db pool exhaustion. (evidence: M-041, L-0285)
- misconfiguration: Config heartbeats are running with differing revisions, indicating possible config changes. (evidence: M-041, L-0288, L-0317)
- downstream_timeout: External dependencies could be failing and causing payments service to error. (evidence: M-041)
